name: @gately/auth-cli
description: CLI for gately-auth — scaffold, migrate, and manage your auth Worker

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const f='dist/index.js';const c=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');if(!c.startsWith('#!/'))fs.writeFileSync(f,'#!/usr/bin/env node\n'+c);fs.chmodSync(f,0o755);"
